item.title: Largest Squid Ever Filmed Captured Near Japan's Ogasawara Islands in 2006
item.description:
Largest Squid Ever Filmed Captured Near Japan’s Ogasawara Islands in 2006

This is the story of the largest squid ever filmed, in December 2006 near Japan’s Ogasawara Islands.

📸 The Event

  • First time the largest squid was ever filmed
  • Occurred in December 2006
  • Location: near Japan’s Ogasawara Islands

🌊 Significance

  • Represents the largest squid ever successfully filmed
  • Adds rare documentation to marine biology records

#MarineBiology #WildlifeFilming #OgasawaraIslands #Squid

Source: Friday Squid Blogging: The Largest Squid Ever Filmed - Schneier on Security

item.title: California Sea Lion and Brandt's Cormorant Spotted at Pillar Point Harbor
item.description:
California Sea Lion and Brandt’s Cormorant Spotted at Pillar Point Harbor

On 19th September 2026 at 10:10 AM, observers recorded marine wildlife at Pillar Point Harbor, CA, US.

🔍 Overview

  • Date: 19th September 2026
  • Time: 10:10 AM
  • Location: Pillar Point Harbor, California, USA

🐾 Species observed

  • California Sea Lion
  • Brandt’s Cormorant
  • Northern Gannet (named Morris) – noted peeking from behind the base of a sign after the photo was taken

📸 Observation details

Species Observation Detail
California Sea Lion Observed in harbor
Brandt’s Cormorant Observed in harbor
Northern Gannet (Morris) Peeking from behind sign after photo taken

#Wildlife #Birds #MarineLife

Source: Sighting: California Sea Lion, Brandt’s Cormorant
